# Legacy Milestones

Manage legacy project milestones in Teamleader Focus.

Milestones of the legacy project system — `milestones.*`.

```php
Teamleader::legacyMilestones()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Projects\LegacyMilestones` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one. Every page: [`lazy()` / `cursor()`](../../guides/pagination.md#fetching-everything) |

## Endpoints

- `milestones.close`
- `milestones.create`
- `milestones.delete`
- `milestones.info`
- `milestones.list`
- `milestones.open`
- `milestones.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `due_after` | Filter milestones due after date (Y-m-d format) |
| `due_before` | Filter milestones due before date (Y-m-d format) |
| `ids` | Array of milestone UUIDs to filter by |
| `project_id` | Filter milestones by project UUID |
| `status` | Filter by milestone status (open, closed) |
| `term` | Search term - searches in milestone title |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `due_on` | Due date |
| `starts_on` | Start date |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `BILLING_METHODS` | `non_invoiceable`, `time_and_materials`, `fixed_price` |
| `CREATE_FIELDS` | `project_id`, `starts_on`, `due_on`, `name`, `description`, `responsible_user_id`, `depends_on`, `custom_fields`, `billing_method`, `budget`, `price` |
| `CURRENCIES` | `BAM`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `CLP`, `CNY`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `INR`, `ISK`, `JPY`, `MAD`, `MXN`, `NOK`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `TRY`, `USD`, `ZAR` |
| `STATUSES` | `open`, `closed` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `starts_on`, `due_on`, `name`, `description`, `responsible_user_id`, `depends_on`, `propagate_date_changes`, `custom_fields` |

## Methods

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get detailed information about a specific milestone

- `$id` — Milestone UUID
- `$includes` — Not used for milestones

### `create()`

```php
create(array $data): array
```

Create a new milestone

- `$data` — Milestone data

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update an existing milestone

- `$id` — Milestone UUID
- `$data` — Data to update

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`

### `delete()`

```php
delete($id, ...$additionalParams): array
```

Delete a milestone

- `$id` — Milestone UUID
- `$additionalParams` — Not used for legacy milestones

### `close()`

```php
close(string $id): array
```

Close a milestone
All open tasks will be closed, open meetings will remain open
Closing the last open milestone will also close the project

- `$id` — Milestone UUID

### `open()`

```php
open(string $id): array
```

(Re)open a milestone
If the milestone's project is closed, the project will be reopened

- `$id` — Milestone UUID

### `forProject()`

```php
forProject(string $projectId, array $options = []): array
```

Get all milestones for a specific project

- `$projectId` — Project UUID
- `$options` — Additional options (pagination, sorting)

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List milestones

- `$filters` — ids, project_id, status (open|closed), due_before, due_after, term
- `$options` — page_size, page_number, sort (due_on|starts_on), sort_order

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On an unknown filter key, option, value or sort field

## Examples

Get all milestones:

```php
$milestones = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->list();
```

Get milestones for a specific project:

```php
$milestones = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->forProject('project-uuid');
```

Get only open milestones:

```php
$milestones = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->list(['status' => 'open']);
```

Get a single milestone:

```php
$milestone = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->info('milestone-uuid');
```

Create a new milestone:

```php
$milestone = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->create([
                'project_id' => 'project-uuid',
                'name' => 'Initial setup',
                'due_on' => '2024-12-31',
                'responsible_user_id' => 'user-uuid',
                'billing_method' => 'time_and_materials'
            ]);
```

Update a milestone:

```php
$result = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->update('milestone-uuid', [
                'name' => 'Updated name',
                'due_on' => '2024-12-31'
            ]);
```

Close a milestone:

```php
$result = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->close('milestone-uuid');
```

Open/reopen a milestone:

```php
$result = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->open('milestone-uuid');
```

Delete a milestone:

```php
$result = Teamleader::legacyMilestones()->delete('milestone-uuid');
```
